breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed the use of Stokes drag in a high Reynolds number regime. The ground truth corrects this by instructing the model to first calculate the Reynolds number and then select the appropriate drag formula based on the result. The agent's generated specification repeated the user's error by explicitly applying the Stokes drag formula without checking if the flow regime was appropriate.
